description: The invoice matches the amended quote exactly: ocean $4,500 plus destination THC, drayage, customs and doc fee at quote rates, with no PSS, congestion or handling lines. The email rate applies (booked Sep 8, by Sep 10) and equals billed, so line 1 is R0. Every other line matches its quote rate (R0). Nothing is waiting, so no question; nothing is at stake, so no draft.
